chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan, from Yunus ibn Ya'qub, from Umar ibn Yazid, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj twenty times.

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: How many times did the Prophet Muhammad perform Hajj according to Shia hadith sources?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib* highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) exceptional devotion by performing Hajj twenty times, a figure often interpreted by Shia scholars as including both the obligatory Hajj of Fard and numerous voluntary (Tatawwu') pilgrimages. This abundance of worship underscores the spiritual merit of the Hajj ritual beyond its legal minimum, reinforcing its role as a means of purification and closeness to God. The report is situated within the chapter on expiation for errors during Ihram, subtly linking the Prophet’s perfect practice to the standards expected of the faithful.
